segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned above the white tray, preparing to interact with the cup lid.
The robot arm moves down and grasps the cup lid on the white tray.
The robot arm lifts the cup lid from the tray and begins moving it to the right.
The robot arm continues moving the cup lid to the right, positioning it over the adjacent area.
The robot arm places the cup lid down on the right side of the tray.
The robot arm releases the cup lid and begins to retract from the tray.
The robot arm completes its retraction and returns to a neutral position above the tray.
The robot arm remains stationary, indicating the completion of the task.
